faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: What people ask us most about the service.

items.question: What is a plate-based driving restriction?
items.answer: It's a restriction on private vehicle circulation based on the last digit of the plate, applied by city on specific days and hours to reduce traffic and pollution.

items.question: How is the data kept up to date?
items.answer: We periodically review each city's official sources. Changes go through review before publishing — nothing updates without verification.

items.question: Does this replace the official source?
items.answer: No. This is reference information. We always include a link to each city's official source so you can verify it directly.

items.question: Can I use the API for free?
items.answer: Yes, the free plan includes a limited number of monthly requests so you can try the API before scaling to a paid plan.

items.question: Which cities and restriction models do you cover?
items.answer: We cover plate-digit restrictions, low emission zones (LEZ) and congestion charges, with growing coverage across LatAm, USA and Spain.

items.question: What does the API include?
items.answer: Three REST endpoints: the list of covered cities, the current rule detail per city (hours, digits, exceptions), and a direct check for whether a specific plate is restricted right now.

items.question: How do I get started with the API?
items.answer: Create a free account, generate an API key from your dashboard, and add it as an authentication header on your requests. The free plan includes a monthly quota so you can test your integration before scaling up.

items.question: What format does the API respond in?
items.answer: All responses are JSON over HTTPS, using the same data shape this website itself consumes.
